[FACT] User is considering getting new tires for their Specialized Allez road bike.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for good brands and models for road bike tires.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended high-end tire options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Continental Grand Prix 5000: Excellent grip, rolling resistance, and puncture protection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Vittoria Corsa G2.0: High-performance tire with improved grip and speed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Michelin Power Competition: Lightweight, responsive tire with excellent grip and puncture resistance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended mid-range tire options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Specialized Turbo Cotton: Designed for speed and comfort with a cotton casing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Schwalbe One: Offers a great balance of grip, speed, and durability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Hutchinson Fusion 5: Versatile tire suitable for both racing and training.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended budget-friendly tire options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Continental Ultra Sport III: Reliable entry-level tire with good grip and durability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Kenda Kountach: Budget-friendly option with a comfortable ride.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Bontrager R3: Solid choice for those on a budget.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing a tire:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Width: Wider tires (25-28mm) provide comfort; narrower tires (23mm) are faster.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Tread pattern: Slick tires are faster; aggressive tread provides better grip in wet conditions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Puncture resistance: Look for built-in protection like Continental's Vectran or Specialized's BlackBelt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Weight: Lighter tires improve acceleration and climbing performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Compatibility: Ensure the tire is compatible with the wheelset and rim type.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking to spend around $50 to $100 per tire.
